title: Full advisee roster
description: One wide table of every advisee with all their information side by side: year, program, GPA, credits earned and planned, plan status, requirements and terms left, holds, conflicts, risk flags, pending overrides and days since last contact, with a footer summary. Rows can be checked for a bulk reminder, and selecting a name opens that advisee.

options.compact: Tight single-line rows to fit the whole caseload with every column on one large screen
options.comfortable: Taller rows with the program under each name, easier to read

options.name: Alphabetical by name
options.risk: Advisees with the most risk flags first
options.last-contact: Advisees not contacted for the longest time first

options.flagged: Only advisees with at least one risk flag
options.under-12: Only advisees planning fewer than 12 credits
options.holds: Only advisees with a registration hold

origin.request: give me a dense table of all of my advisees and their info
